data.title: Panic Clone Escape
data.statement:
You are guiding a clone through a 2D facility. The clone walks continuously in one direction until it hits a wall, which makes it turn around. Your goal is to determine if the clone needs to be blocked (which also makes it turn around) to reach the target on its current floor.

The target is either the exitPos (if the clone is on the exitFloor), or an elevatorPos on the clone's current floor.
For each clone state provided, you must output WAIT if the clone is walking towards its target, or BLOCK if it is walking away from its target or is about to hit the outer walls (position 0 or width-1).
data.constraints:
1 ≤ width ≤ 100
0 ≤ exitFloor < 100
The clone will never be on a floor without an elevator or exit.
data.stubGenerator:
read nbFloors:int width:int nbTurns:int exitFloor:int exitPos:int nbTotalClones:int nbAdditionalElevators:int nbElevators:int
loop nbElevators read elevatorFloor:int elevatorPos:int
loop nbTurns read cloneFloor:int clonePos:int direction:word(10)
data.inputDescription:
Line 1: 8 space-separated integers: nbFloors width nbRounds exitFloor exitPos nbTotalClones nbAdditionalElevators nbElevators
Next nbElevators lines: 2 integers elevatorFloor elevatorPos
Following lines until EOF: 2 integers and 1 string cloneFloor clonePos direction (direction is "RIGHT" or "LEFT").
data.outputDescription: For each clone state given, print WAIT if the clone is walking in the correct direction, or BLOCK if it is walking away from the target/elevator.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You are guiding a clone through a 2D facility. The clone walks continuously in one direction until it hits a wall, which makes it turn around. Your goal is to determine if the clone needs to be blocked (which also makes it turn around) to reach the target on its current floor.

The target is either the exitPos (if the clone is on the exitFloor), or an elevatorPos on the clone's current floor.
For each clone state provided, you must output WAIT if the clone is walking towards its target, or BLOCK if it is walking away from its target or is about to hit the outer walls (position 0 or width-1).
Input
Line 1: 8 space-separated integers: nbFloors width nbRounds exitFloor exitPos nbTotalClones nbAdditionalElevators nbElevators
Next nbElevators lines: 2 integers elevatorFloor elevatorPos
Following lines until EOF: 2 integers and 1 string cloneFloor clonePos direction (direction is "RIGHT" or "LEFT").
Output
For each clone state given, print WAIT if the clone is walking in the correct direction, or BLOCK if it is walking away from the target/elevator.
Constraints
1 ≤ width ≤ 100
0 ≤ exitFloor < 100
The clone will never be on a floor without an elevator or exit.
Example
Input
1 13 1 0 9 10 0 0
0 4 RIGHT
Output
WAIT
